About

Hello, I'm Tomas.

TLnagarut is a custom cabinetry and solid wood door workshop in Haifa, led by Tomas, with 25 years in the trade.

We make custom cabinets and kitchens, built-in furniture and solid wood doors, and we also do commercial work. Everything is made in our own workshop — design, cutting, assembly and spray finishing — and we deliver and install it ourselves, across Haifa and the north.

Tomas trained on demanding residential and commercial projects in the UK.

  • 25 years in the trade
  • Custom made to order
  • Haifa our own workshop, from design to installation

What we make

Made to measure, made in-house.

Kitchens & cabinets

Custom kitchens and cabinets, made to measure. Panels are cut and edge-banded in our workshop and fitted with Blum drawer systems and hardware.

Built-in furniture

Built-in furniture and storage, designed around your space and installed by us.

Solid wood doors

Solid wood doors made in our workshop and spray-finished in our own booth.

Repair & restoration

We also repair and restore existing wooden furniture.
